answer: The opal schedule is applied in lotus and grove reveals each instalment. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 38% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2574 identities would post 4907 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
